stemMd: For a constant $b$, $7x+b=3(2x+5)$ has solution $x=-4$. What is $b$?
explanationMd: Simplify to 7x+b=6x+15, so b=15−x. At x=−4, b=19. Directly, −28+19=−9 and 3(−8+5)=−9.

distractorRationale.b: This subtracts the solution instead of adding its magnitude in b=15−x.
